claims.text: Consider one: oral glycerol 1 mL/kg diluted with an equal amount of cold water, IV mannitol, or oral isosorbide 100 g (220 mL of a 45% solution; not isosorbide dinitrate)
claims.quote: consider an osmotic agent, such as oral glycerol 1 mL/kg diluted with an equal amount of cold water, mannitol 1.0 to 1.5 mg/kg IV, or isosorbide 100 g orally (220 mL of a 45% solution). (NOTE: This form of isosorbide is not isosorbide dinitrate.)
